snippet.title: My Splitting Image - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
- 🇮🇹 Italiano -
🎮 My Splitting Image è un'avventura horror psicologico dove interpreti Sipriest, un uomo incapace di riconoscere il proprio riflesso, tormentato e al tempo stesso accolto da una figura enigmatica con un libro incastonato nel volto. Il gioco sarà disponibile dal 13 luglio 2025 – non perderlo!

🔗 Link utili
Pagina Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479790/My_Splitting_Image/

Instagram Late Night Artisans: https://www.instagram.com/lna_dev_team/

TikTok Late Night Artisans: https://www.tiktok.com/@latenightartisans

🎥 Per i content creator
Se sei un creator e vuoi creare contenuti su My Splitting Image, possiamo fornire una chiave di accesso anticipato. Contattami direttamente via email: francescoemilianopiroddi@gmail.com

- 🇪🇳 English -
🎮 My Splitting Image is a psychological horror adventure in which you play Sipriest, a man unable to recognize his own reflection, tormented and yet drawn closer by a mysterious figure with a book embedded in his face. The game will be available from July 13, 2025 – don't miss it!

🔗 Useful Links
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479790/My_Splitting_Image/

Instagram Late Night Artisans: https://www.instagram.com/lna_dev_team/

TikTok Late Night Artisans: https://www.tiktok.com/@latenightartisans

🎥 For Content Creators
Are you a content creator interested in My Splitting Image? We can provide an early access key. Contact me directly via email at francescoemilianopiroddi@gmail.com
